tools.name: hiboutik_list_stores
tools.description: List the shops (stores) of the account: id, name, warehouse id, currency, time zone, address. Use store ids for sales, payment types and reports. GET /stores.

tools.name: hiboutik_list_warehouses
tools.description: List warehouses (stock locations) with id and name. Use the ids for stock levels. GET /warehouses.

tools.name: hiboutik_list_users
tools.description: List the Hiboutik users (staff, sales vendors): id, name, email, access level. The id is the vendor_id of a sale. Passwords and keys are never returned. GET /users.

tools.name: hiboutik_list_taxes
tools.description: List the tax (VAT) rates with id, name, value and default flag. GET /taxes.

tools.name: hiboutik_list_payment_types
tools.description: List the payment types enabled in a store (cash, card, cheque...) with currency and flags. GET /payment_types/{store_id}/.

tools.name: hiboutik_list_categories
tools.description: List product categories (newest id first) with parent id and flags. GET /categories.

tools.name: hiboutik_list_brands
tools.description: List product brands (newest id first). GET /brands.

tools.name: hiboutik_list_suppliers
tools.description: List the suppliers with id, name and contact details. GET /suppliers/.

tools.name: hiboutik_list_size_types
tools.description: List the variant (size) types, such as clothing sizes or colours. Use an id with hiboutik_list_sizes. GET /size_types.

tools.name: hiboutik_list_sizes
tools.description: List the variants (sizes) of one variant type: size_id and name. The size_id identifies a variant of a product in stock and sales. GET /sizes/{size_type_id}.

tools.name: hiboutik_list_products
tools.description: List products (default newest id first) with model, barcode, price, supply price, brand, category, supplier and stock management flag. 250 per page. GET /products/.

tools.name: hiboutik_get_product
tools.description: One product with its full details. GET /products/{product_id}.

tools.name: hiboutik_search_products_by_name
tools.description: Find products whose model (name) matches the text. GET /products/search/name/{q}.

tools.name: hiboutik_find_product_by_barcode
tools.description: Find the product (and variant) with this barcode. GET /products/search/barcode/{barcode}/.

tools.name: hiboutik_search_products
tools.description: Search products by model, category, brand, supplier, archived state, supplier or external reference. GET /products/search/.

tools.name: hiboutik_stock_all_warehouses
tools.description: Available stock per product and variant across warehouses, optionally filtered by category, brand, supplier or archived state. GET /stock_available/all_wh.

tools.name: hiboutik_stock_by_warehouse
tools.description: Available stock per product and variant in one warehouse, optionally filtered. GET /stock_available/warehouse_id/{warehouse_id}.

tools.name: hiboutik_stock_by_product
tools.description: Available stock of one product per variant and warehouse, with the inventory alert level. GET /stock_available/product_id/{product_id}.

tools.name: hiboutik_list_stock_orders
tools.description: List the stock orders / goods receipts. GET /inventory_inputs/.

tools.name: hiboutik_list_customers
tools.description: List customers (newest id first) with name, email, phone, country, loyalty points and store credit. Personal data of the shop's customers. GET /customers/.

tools.name: hiboutik_search_customers
tools.description: Search customers by last name, first name, email, phone, VAT number, country, customer code or external reference (each text value needs at least 3 characters). Dates: yyyy-mm-dd, or prefix with > < >= <= to compare. GET /customers/search/.

tools.name: hiboutik_get_customer
tools.description: One customer with full details. GET /customer/{customers_id}.

tools.name: hiboutik_list_customer_sales
tools.description: List the sales made to one customer (newest first). GET /customer/{customers_id}/sales/.

tools.name: hiboutik_get_sale
tools.description: One sale with its header, totals, payment and line items. GET /sales/{sale_id}.

tools.name: hiboutik_list_open_sales
tools.description: List the sales not yet closed in a store (newest first). GET /open_sales/{store_id}.

tools.name: hiboutik_list_closed_sales
tools.description: List the closed (completed) sales of a store for one day, or for a whole month when day is omitted. GET /closed_sales/{store_id}/{year}/{month}[/{day}].

tools.name: hiboutik_report_turnover
tools.description: Sales total (turnover) of a store for one day, or per day for a whole month when day is omitted. GET /reports/turnover/{store_id}/{year}/{month}[/{day}].

tools.name: hiboutik_report_products_sold
tools.description: Products sold in a store during one month: quantities and revenue per product. GET /reports/products/{store_id}/{year}/{month}.

tools.name: hiboutik_create_customer
tools.description: WRITE: create a customer in Hiboutik. Needs at least a last name, first name, company or email. Returns the new customer id. POST /customers/.

tools.name: hiboutik_update_customer
tools.description: WRITE: change ONE attribute of a customer (it overwrites the current value). Attributes: gender (0 unknown, 1 male, 2 female), last_name, first_name, email, company, phone, vat, country, date_of_birth, customers_code, comments, validity, customers_ref_ext, customers_misc. PUT /customer/{customers_id

tools.name: hiboutik_set_sale_comment
tools.description: WRITE: add or replace the comment of a sale (it overwrites any existing comment). POST /sales/comments/.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "hiboutik_list_users" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: List the Hiboutik users (staff, sales vendors): id, name, email, access level. The id is the vendor_id of a sale. Passwords and keys are never returned. GET /us…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: hiboutik_list_users, hiboutik_list_customers, hiboutik_search_customers · Private data: hiboutik_list_users, hiboutik_list_suppliers · Public sink: hiboutik_list_users, hiboutik_list_customers, hiboutik_search_customers, hiboutik_create_customer, hiboutik_update_customer, hiboutik_set_sale_comment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: hiboutik_list_users, hiboutik_list_customers, hiboutik_search_customers · Private data: hiboutik_list_users, hiboutik_list_suppliers · Public sink: hiboutik_list_users, hiboutik_list_customers, hiboutik_search_customers, hiboutik_create_customer, hiboutik_update_customer, hiboutik_set_sale_comment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
